provenance.model_hash_scope: Canonical resolved physical sections and configuration schema version; excludes controller, experiment, and evidence labels.
provenance.implementation_hash_scope: Canonical mapping of the Python source and build/dependency file hashes captured when the package loaded; environment versions are reported separately.
provenance.profile_policy: Bundled profile is frozen at server startup; the API cannot edit or replace it.

assumptions: Synthetic single-ring teaching model; no measured private device geometry or transient validation.
The step controller stabilizes a known local negative-detuning fringe; it does not acquire a resonance or identify the correct wavelength.
Initial temperatures are 300 K. The initial heater code is already applied, then temperatures evolve during warm-up.
Stationary NRZ photon-memory averaging uses ideal electrical edges and independent bits; this is not a bit-resolved waveform or BER prediction.
The detector follows package temperature. Thermal capacities, conductances, geometry, and most device parameters are assumptions requiring calibration.
Both comparisons use the same physical parameters, initial state, sensor-noise seed, and ambient disturbance.
The 3D view is a schematic driven by recorded state; it is not a spatial field solution or a device layout.

metrics.claim: conditional synthetic plant; no measured Lightmatter transient validation
metrics.metric_note: OMA and heater energy use adaptive continuous integrals. Detuning extrema use both event sides; wrong-line time uses interval-end identity and can miss intra-interval crossings. Temperature extrema use accepted solver states. Neither extrema nor occupancy are continuous safety bounds. Heater rail time means DAC code rails, not all analog current/power limits.
metrics.ber_note: No receiver/noise calibration: OMA is not a BER prediction.

control.note: Recorded released ADC readings whose physical sample time is at or after the disturbance; target-band occupancy does not prove lock or acquisition.

diagnostics.event_boundary_convention: integer-tick canonical right limits; integration closes on the pre-event left limit

spectral_table.reason: quarter/midpoint and independent heldout checks passed
spectral_table.interpretation: Sampled interpolation validation of the stated compact model, not a device-accuracy claim or rigorous uniform bound.

diagnostics.stationary_nrz_note: Photon memory near resonance, exact quasistatic tails, continuous blend; ideal electrical edges and iid bits.
diagnostics.nearest_line_note: Nearest periodic resonance is an identity-risk diagnostic even when no lane is locked.
